experiments.headline: PASS e01-protocol: 26/26 checks
limitations: Only handshake-level frames are captured here; turn-level events are covered by E02.

experiments.headline: PASS e02-turn: 12/12 checks
limitations: The scripted model is local; no paid provider is contacted. Tool approval is bypassed here via --approval-mode yolo and is covered by E04.

experiments.headline: PASS e03-interaction: 23/23 checks
limitations: The timeout case relies on a dialog-level timeout supplied by the extension (800ms), not on client-side timing.

experiments.headline: PASS e04-approval: 29/29 checks
limitations: The gate is an experiment extension loaded with --extension; production wiring is M2. Model tool-call approval modes were not set to yolo for these runs.

experiments.headline: PASS e05-cancel: 17/17 checks
limitations: In-protocol stop (abort + abort_bash) did NOT reclaim the OS process of the running command in rpc-ui mode; the desktop stop path needs a process-tree termination fallback, which the bridge-level kill provides (scenario 3).
Process termination is asserted on Linux via a self-written PID; macOS/Windows semantics are not covered here.

experiments.headline: PASS e06-session: 23/23 checks
limitations: Session naming/restore are verified over RPC only; desktop-side metadata mapping is M2/M4 work.

experiments.headline: PASS e07-isolation: 23/23 checks
limitations: Rules are only injected when bucketed by frontmatter (`alwaysApply: true`, or a `description` for the rulebook); a bare markdown file in rules/ is read but never reaches the prompt. Relevant to T19.

The MCP server from the isolated project config is discovered, spawned, and handshaken, but its tool is NOT in the model's tool list in this configuration (OMP advertises a curated 12-tool subset); MCP tool surfacing is T19/M5 work.
Credential isolation is proven for environment variables; OS keychain/system-store naming is deferred to M4 packaging.
The user's ~/.omp is read only to compare model ids; it is never written by these experiments.

experiments.headline: PASS e08-host-tools: 23/23 checks
limitations: The host tool also passed through the extension tool_call hook.
The host-tool exchange is a real capture; the fake provider only supplies model turns.

experiments.headline: PASS e09-transport: 30/30 checks
limitations: Bridge-disconnect handling is asserted as 'OMP exits by itself and the group is reaped'; the desktop-side reconnect policy is M2/T09.
Line-cap enforcement is specified by lib/ndjson.mjs; the production reader is M2/T09 and must adopt an explicit cap (Node's readline has no line limit).
Windows/macOS process reclamation is not covered here.

experiments.headline: PASS e10-modes: 18/18 checks
limitations: ACP and SDK paths were read in source only; M1 selects rpc-ui and does not need them, so no runtime comparison is claimed.
